style: 2D anime fighting-game sprite, clean closed lineart, two-tone cel shading, readable silhouette

rimuru-slime.use: cinematic / portrait / dialogue only — no combat PNG sheets
rimuru-slime.combat: story fights use the procedural slime blob; roster combat art is rimuru-shizu
rimuru-slime.silhouette: teardrop gel blob, wider than tall
rimuru-slime.face: two short dark dashes for eyes, tiny mouth dash, oval blush marks
rimuru-slime.forbidden: human limbs, Shizu coat, hair, gold eyes

rimuru-shizu.hair: long straight cyan to mid-back, sharp bangs
rimuru-shizu.coat: black high collar, white stripe on right shoulder, dark fur collar

rules: Same canvas size for every frame of one clip
Transparent export after chroma, no crop that changes canvas
No projectile / beam / explosion in character frames
Do not put human frames in slime form folders
Do not produce combat animations for rimuru-slime; portraits and cutscenes only
